blocks.en: The crucial result concerning the solvability of equations is the inverse function theorem, which says that locally an equation is uniquely solvable if its linearization is.
blocks.zh: 关于方程可解性的关键结果是逆函数定理, 它说明若方程的线性化局部唯一可解, 则该方程也局部唯一可解.

blocks.en: Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces and let $U$ be an open neighborhood of the origin in $X$. Let $F:U\to Y$ be continuously differentiable and assume that $F^{\prime}(0)\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ is one-to-one and onto. Then there exists an open neighborhood $V$ of $F(0)$ in $Y$ and a continuously differentiable mapping $G:V\to X$ with the property that $F(G(y))=y$. Moreover, $G(y)$ is the only sufficiently small solution $x$ of the equation $F(x)=y$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 和 $Y$ 为 Banach 空间, $U$ 为 $X$ 中原点的开邻域. 设 $F:U\to Y$ 连续可微, 并假设 $F^{\prime}(0)\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 既单又满. 则存在 $Y$ 中 $F(0)$ 的开邻域 $V$ 及连续可微映射 $G:V\to X$, 使 $F(G(y))=y$. 此外, $G(y)$ 是方程 $F(x)=y$ 的唯一足够小的解 $x$.
blocks.label: thm:banach-inverse-function
